title: UPS Battery — Low Charge
description: UPS battery level P093 = {val}%. Battery backup time estimated {val2} minutes. CNC memory protection duration may be insufficient for extended power outage.
probable_cause: Battery aging, recent extended power interruption, or battery charger fault.
diagnostic_steps: Check battery age against replacement schedule (typically 3–5 years)
remedy: Recharge UPS. If charge does not recover to >80% within 24h, replace battery.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
escalation_path: If ELC-MD-001 is not addressed (log fault. schedule maintenance within 24 hours. reduce feed rate by 20%.), the fault will escalate in this order: ELC-CR-001, then ELC-MN-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
